content.title: 'Shrinking' Season 4 Is Official—Here’s What We Know
content.text: Key Points'Shrinking' was officially renewed for Season 4 before Season 3 even premiered.The core cast, including Jason Segel and Harrison Ford, is expected to return.While no release date is set, Season 4 is likely to arrive sometime in early 2027. If you just finished the season finale of Shrinking Season 3, I have some very good news—there’s more of the hit dramedy coming. Apple TV+ officially renewed the series for Season 4 in January 2026. Notably, the announcement came before Season 3 even premiered, which is a strong signal of confidence in one of the platform’s most beloved shows. What does all of this mean for Shrinking Season 4? Here’s what we know. At the moment, there’s no official premiere date, but based on the show’s past release schedule, early 2027 is a likely window. Fans may have a bit of a wait, but the early renewal suggests the creative team has time to map out what comes next. More good news! The core cast is expected to return. That includes: Jason Segel as Jimmy Harrison Ford as Paul Jessica Williams as Gaby Christa Miller as Liz Michael Urie as Brian Luke Tennie as Sean Lukita Maxwell as Alice Ted McGinley as Derek ‘Shrinking’ Wasn’t Supposed to Go This Far Interestingly, Shrinking wasn’t originally planned to run this long. Co-creator Bill Lawrence previously described the show as a three-season arc, exploring themes like grief, forgiveness and moving forward. Moreover, Season 3 definitely feels like it could be the final season of the show, what with nearly every character starting a new chapter in their life. Paul is moving to Connecticut; Alice going off to college; Sean is starting a new career; Gaby is moving forward with her trauma center; Jimmy is…well, Jimmy. Season 4, then, opens the door to something new; an extension of the story beyond its original blueprint. By renewing the show ahead of Season 3’s debut, Apple TV+ made it clear that Shrinking is a priority for the platform. The series has earned strong reviews, award recognition and a loyal fanbase, all of which likely contributed to the decision. Of course, plot details are still under wraps. But Season 3 has already been setting up major emotional arcs, particularly around Paul’s Parkinson’s diagnosis and Jimmy’s evolving personal life. With Season 4 confirmed, those storylines now have room to grow rather than wrap up quickly. For now, fans can rewatch Seasons 1-3 of Shrinking on Apple TV+ with the reassurance that more is officially on the way.
